title: Persistent drafted-player state
source_feedback: Reload lost all info on who was already drafted.
user_impact: Reload during draft destroys trust and forces manual reconstruction.
acceptance_criteria: Assigned picks autosave locally and restore after reload; drafted players remain hidden/marked; draft board restores.
risk: Runtime write failure or accidental source mutation.

title: Draft event log
source_feedback: Need to know and preserve what happened during the draft.
user_impact: No audit trail for picks/trades/undo/reset.
acceptance_criteria: Every assign, undo, remove, edit, trade, reset is logged with timestamp and mode.
risk: Event log bloat or stale state if not versioned.

title: Export draft log
source_feedback: Need recoverable draft record.
user_impact: No fallback if app/session fails.
acceptance_criteria: Export CSV/JSON/MD draft log from local runtime state.
risk: Export may include local-only paths; keep safe.

title: Reset with confirmation
source_feedback: Reset should not be accidental.
user_impact: Accidental reset could erase draft progress.
acceptance_criteria: Reset requires explicit confirmation and writes reset event.
risk: Bad confirmation UX can still be dangerous.

title: In-draft trade event entry
source_feedback: Traded away 1.04 for 2028 1st + 2.03 and had no way to make that trade.
user_impact: User had to draft for other teams after trade.
acceptance_criteria: Trade form records gives/gets, current/future picks, teams, notes.
risk: Trade entry could mutate source truth if scoped poorly.

title: Pick ownership update after trade
source_feedback: Need draft board/model context to know who owns pick after trade.
user_impact: Draft board becomes wrong after trades.
acceptance_criteria: Current-year traded picks update owner/current pick display immediately.
risk: Future pick ownership ambiguity.

title: Future pick ledger
source_feedback: Trade received 2028 1st and needs to be remembered.
user_impact: Future value disappears during draft.
acceptance_criteria: Future picks are stored in event log and Your Team sidebar.
risk: Future pick labels may be incomplete.

title: Drafting Mode entry
source_feedback: Need Drafting Mode separate from normal/post-draft mode.
user_impact: Draft tools feel buried in normal app.
acceptance_criteria: Enter Draft Room button near top left; user chooses Live Draft or Mock Draft.
risk: Navigation clutter.

title: Live/Mock draft choice
source_feedback: Enter draft room should choose live or mock.
user_impact: Mock and live workflows can be confused.
acceptance_criteria: Mode selector creates separate runtime namespaces.
risk: Cross-contamination between mock/live state.

title: Pick-by-pick draft room
source_feedback: Should look similar for every pick whether mine or other team's.
user_impact: Hard to track other teams' picks.
acceptance_criteria: Current pick panel works for any owner and supports manual picked-player search/selection.
risk: Too much UI variation between owners.

title: Draft room top tabs
source_feedback: Likes tabs: Cheat Sheets, Draft Board, Trade Lab, Player Compare.
user_impact: Draft tools are scattered.
acceptance_criteria: Top tab layout inside Drafting Mode.
risk: Tab clutter if too many diagnostics included.

title: Player Compare decision summary
source_feedback: Compare had useful data but was super confusing.
user_impact: Hard to decide under pressure.
acceptance_criteria: Compare starts with concise verdict, reasons, risks, confidence; details behind expanders.
risk: Oversimplification may hide important caveats.

title: Jameson vs Brian compare proof
source_feedback: User specifically compared Jameson Williams vs Brian Thomas Jr.
user_impact: Need real example acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Browser proof with that pair if both are available in source data.
risk: Player availability may differ by source.

title: Injury model transparency
source_feedback: Concern: per-game output vs injured yearly totals vs recovery risk.
user_impact: User cannot tell if injury is handled correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Document/display separate per-game, annual total, injury-shortened year, recovery risk, chronic risk.
risk: Data may be missing; must not fabricate.

title: Injury history penalty contract
source_feedback: Bad injury history should lower trust/value or show warning.
user_impact: Risky players may look too clean.
acceptance_criteria: Audit source availability and define confidence cap/warning before any scoring.
risk: Unsupported injury source could create false confidence.

title: Trade Finder trade-back tool
source_feedback: I don't like this pick; find trade-back options.
user_impact: User lacks action when board tier is bad.
acceptance_criteria: Trade Finder suggests conservative trade-back ranges/packages and tier-drop risk.
risk: May be mistaken for final trade advice.

title: Trade For falling-player tool
source_feedback: A player is falling; cheapest way to trade for that pick?
user_impact: User cannot capitalize on falling player.
acceptance_criteria: Trade For suggests cheapest internal packages and warnings for target pick/player.
risk: External trade calculator leakage.

title: Global draft search
source_feedback: Need search when another team picks a player not top five.
user_impact: Cannot quickly mark off-table picks.
acceptance_criteria: Search can find any draftable player and assign to current/selected pick.
risk: Search misses aliases/unmatched players.

title: Your Team sidebar
source_feedback: User likes Your Team on left.
user_impact: Owned picks/roster/trades not visible enough.
acceptance_criteria: Left sidebar shows roster, owned picks, future picks, drafted players, trade events.
risk: Team needs should not override best player value.

title: Configurable info density
source_feedback: Likes dropdowns to decide variation/amount of information.
user_impact: Too much or too little info under pressure.
acceptance_criteria: Controls for number of players and summary/detailed/expert-style notes where supported.
risk: Unsupported note styles could become fluff.

title: Overall cheat sheet first
source_feedback: Most likely to use overall, not per-position.
user_impact: Per-position view is less useful on clock.
acceptance_criteria: Cheat Sheet defaults to overall ranking with position filters secondary.
risk: Overall rank must remain review-labeled if candidate-based.

title: Tier separation
source_feedback: Tiers separated like cheat sheet would be nice.
user_impact: Hard to see value cliffs.
acceptance_criteria: Visual tier separators or clear tier headers.
risk: Streamlit table limitations.

title: Normal/Post-Draft Mode
source_feedback: Wants drafting mode and another post-draft/normal mode.
user_impact: App modes blur together.
acceptance_criteria: Normal Mode and Post-Draft Mode are separate from Drafting Mode.
risk: Mode complexity.

title: Post-draft recap
source_feedback: Post-draft mode all about afterwards.
user_impact: Need review after draft.
acceptance_criteria: Draft log recap, picks made, trades made, passed players, next actions.
risk: Could imply final roster advice without review.

title: Settings data health for runtime state
source_feedback: Need know autosave/runtime health.
user_impact: Silent save failure would be catastrophic.
acceptance_criteria: Settings shows runtime path, active draft id, autosave status, last save, event count.
risk: False green if not actually writing.

title: Final V2 browser acceptance
source_feedback: Do not call GREEN unless human workflow works.
user_impact: Tech tests are insufficient.
acceptance_criteria: Browser proof: reload restore, trade example, compare summary, trade tools, cheat sheet, search, modes.
risk: Late integration conflict.
